items.hebrew: אַתָּה בְּחַרְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הָעַמִּים, אָהַבְתָּ אוֹתָנוּ וְרָצִיתָ בָּנוּ, וְרוֹמַמְתָּנוּ מִכָּל הַלְּשׁוֹנוֹת, וְקִדַּשְׁתָּנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, וְקֵרַבְתָּנוּ מַלְכֵּנוּ לַעֲבוֹדָתֶךָ, וְשִׁמְךָ הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ עָלֵינוּ קָרָאתָ.
items.translation: You have chosen us from all the peoples; You loved us and found favor in us. You raised us above all tongues and sanctified us with Your commandments; You brought us near, our King, to Your service, and called Your great and holy name upon us.
items.translit: ʾatta bĕḥartanu mikkol ha'ammim, ʾahavta ʾothanu wĕraṣitha banu, wĕromamtanu mikkol hallĕshonoth, wĕqiddashtanu bĕmiṣwothekha, wĕqeravtanu malkenu la'ăvodhathekha, wĕshimkha haggadhol wĕhaqqadhosh 'alenu qaraʾtha.

items.hebrew: וַתּוֹדִיעֵנוּ מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ, וַתְּלַמְּדֵנוּ לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם חֻקֵּי רְצוֹנֶךָ, וַתִּתֶּן לָנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה מִשְׁפָּטִים יְשָׁרִים וְתוֹרוֹת אֱמֶת, חֻקִּים וּמִצְוֹת טוֹבִים, וַתַּנְחִילֵנוּ זְמַנֵּי שָׂשׂוֹן וּמוֹעֲדֵי קֹדֶשׁ וְחַגֵּי נְדָבָה, וַתּוֹרִישֵׁנוּ קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת וּכְבוֹד מוֹעֵד וַחֲגִיגַת הָרֶגֶל. בֵּין קְדֻשַּׁת שַׁבָּת לִקְדֻשַּׁת יוֹם טוֹב הִבְדַּלְתָּ, וְאֶת יוֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִי מִשֵּׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַמַּעֲשֶׂה הִקְדַּשְׁתָּ, וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ וְהִקְדַּשְׁתָּ אֶת עַמְּךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתָךְ:
items.translation: You made known to us Your righteous laws, and taught us to perform the statutes of Your will. You gave us, Adhonay our God, in love, upright judgments and true teachings, good statutes and commandments. You gave us as our heritage seasons of joy, holy festivals and freewill feasts, and bequeathed to us the holiness of Shabbath, the honor of the festival and the celebration of the pilgrim feast. Between the holiness of Shabbath and the holiness of the festival You have distinguished; the seventh day You have made holy above the six days of work; You have set apart and made holy Your people Israel with Your holiness.
items.translit: wattodhi'enu mishpĕṭe ṣidhqekha, wattĕlammĕdhenu la'ăsoth bahem ḥuqqe rĕṣonekha, wattitten lanu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bĕʾahăva mishpaṭim yĕsharim wĕthoroth ʾĕmeth, ḥuqqim umiṣwoth ṭovim, wattanḥilenu zĕmanne sason umo'ădhe qodhesh wĕḥagge nĕdhava, wattorishenu qĕdhushshath shabbath ukhĕvodh mo'edh waḥăghighath hareghel. ben qĕdhushshath shabbath liqdhushshath yom ṭov hivdalta, wĕʾeth yom hashshĕvi'i mishshesheth yĕme hamma'ăseh hiqdashta, wĕhivdalta wĕhiqdashta ʾeth 'ammĕkha yisraʾel biqdhushshathakh:

items.hebrew: וַתִּֽתֶּן לָֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בְּאַהֲבָה [בשבת: שַׁבָּתוֹת לִמְנוּחָה וּ]מוֹעֲדִים לְשִׂמְחָה, חַגִּים וּזְמַנִּים לְשָׂשׂוֹן, אֶת יוֹם [בשבת: הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה, וְאֶת יוֹם]
items.translation: In love, Adhonay our God, You have given us [on Shabbath: Shabbaths for rest, and] appointed times for gladness, festivals and seasons for joy: the day of [on Shabbath: this Shabbath, and the day of]
items.translit: wattitten lanu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bĕʾahăva [on Shabbath: shabbathoth limnuḥa u]mo'ădhim lĕsimḥa, ḥaggim uzĕmannim lĕsason, ʾeth yom [on Shabbath: hashshabbath hazzeh, wĕʾeth yom]

items.translation: On Pesaḥ:

items.hebrew: חַג הַמַּצּוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן חֵרוּתֵנוּ
items.translation: this Festival of Maṣṣoth, this festival day set apart, the season of our freedom,
items.translit: ḥagh hammaṣṣoth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman ḥeruthenu

items.translation: On Shavu'oth:

items.hebrew: חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָתֵֽינוּ
items.translation: this Festival of Shavu'oth, this festival day set apart, the season of the giving of our Torah,
items.translit: ḥagh hashshavu'oth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman mattan torathenu

items.translation: On Sukkoth:

items.hebrew: חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵֽנוּ
items.translation: this Festival of Sukkoth, this festival day set apart, the season of our rejoicing,
items.translit: ḥagh hassukkoth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman simḥathenu

items.translation: On Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth:

items.hebrew: שְׁמִינִי חַג עֲצֶֽרֶת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵֽנוּ
items.translation: this Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth, the Festival of Assembly, this festival day set apart, the season of our rejoicing,
items.translit: shĕmini ḥagh 'ăṣereth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman simḥathenu

items.hebrew: בְּאַהֲבָה מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ זֵֽכֶר לִיצִיאַת מִצְרָֽיִם.
items.translation: in love, a day set apart, a memorial of the going out from Egypt.
items.translit: bĕʾahăva miqraʾ qodhesh zekher liṣiʾath miṣrayīm.

items.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, יַעֲלֶה וְיָבֹא, וְיַגִּֽיעַ וְיֵרָאֶה, וְיֵרָצֶה וְיִשָּׁמַע, וְיִפָּקֵד וְיִזָּכֵר, זִכְרוֹנֵֽנוּ וְזִכְרוֹן אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, זִכְרוֹן יְרוּשָׁלַֽיִם עִירָךְ, וְזִכְרוֹן מָשִֽׁיחַ בֶּן־דָּוִד עַבְדָּךְ, וְזִכְרוֹן כָּל־עַמְּךָ בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל לְפָנֶֽיךָ, לִפְלֵיטָה, לְטוֹבָה, לְחֵן, לְחֶֽסֶד וּלְרַחֲמִים, לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים וּלְשָׁלוֹם, בְּיוֹם [בשבת: הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה, וּבְיוֹם]
items.translation: Our God and God of our forefathers, may there rise and come, arrive and be seen, find favor and be heard, be recalled and be remembered before You our remembrance and the remembrance of our forefathers, the remembrance of Jerusalem, Your city, the remembrance of the Messiah, son of David, Your servant, and the remembrance of all Your people, the house of Israel — for deliverance, for good, for grace, for loving-kindness and compassion, for good life and for peace, on the day of [on Shabbath: this Shabbath, and on the day of]
items.translit: ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, ya'ăleh wĕyavoʾ, wĕyaggia' wĕyeraʾeh, wĕyeraṣeh wĕyishshama', wĕyippaqedh wĕyizzakher, zikhronenu wĕzikhron ʾăvothenu, zikhron yĕrushalayim 'irakh, wĕzikhron mashiaḥ ben-dhawīdh 'avdakh, wĕzikhron kol-'ammĕkha beth yisraʾel lĕfanekha, lifleṭa, lĕṭova, lĕḥen, lĕḥesedh ulĕraḥămim, lĕḥayyim ṭovim ulĕshalom, bĕyom [on Shabbath: hashshabbath hazzeh, uvĕyom]

items.translation: On Pesaḥ:
this Festival of Maṣṣoth,
items.translit: ḥagh hammaṣṣoth hazzeh,

items.translation: On Shavu'oth:
this Festival of Shavu'oth,
items.translit: ḥagh hashshavu'oth hazzeh,

items.translation: On Sukkoth:
this Festival of Sukkoth,
items.translit: ḥagh hassukkoth hazzeh,

items.translation: On Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth:
this Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth, the Festival of Assembly,
items.translit: shĕmini ḥagh 'ăṣereth hazzeh,

items.hebrew: בְּיוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, לְרַחֵם בּוֹ עָלֵֽינוּ וּלְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ. זָכְרֵֽנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ בּוֹ לְטוֹבָה, וּפָקְדֵֽנוּ בוֹ לִבְרָכָה, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ בוֹ לְחַיִּים טוֹבִים, בִּדְבַר יְשׁוּעָה וְרַחֲמִים. חוּס וְחָנֵּֽנוּ, וַחֲמוֹל וְרַחֵם עָלֵֽינוּ, וְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ כִּי אֵלֶֽיךָ עֵינֵֽינוּ, כִּי אֵל מֶֽלֶךְ חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם אָֽתָּה:
items.translation: on this festival day set apart, to have mercy on us on it and to save us. Remember us on it, Adhonay our God, for good; recall us on it for blessing; and save us on it for good life. With a word of salvation and compassion, spare us and be gracious to us, have pity and mercy on us, and save us; for our eyes are on You, for You are God, a gracious and compassionate King.
items.translit: bĕyom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, lĕraḥem bo 'alenu ulĕhoshi'enu. zakhĕrenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu bo lĕṭova, ufaqĕdhenu vo livrakha, wĕhoshi'enu vo lĕḥayyim ṭovim, bidhvar yĕshu'a wĕraḥămim. ḥus wĕḥannenu, waḥămol wĕraḥem 'alenu, wĕhoshi'enu ki ʾelekha 'enenu, ki ʾel melekh ḥannun wĕraḥum ʾatta:

items.hebrew: וְהַשִּׂיאֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶת בִּרְכַּת מוֹעֲדֶיךָ לְחַיִּים בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׁלוֹם, כַּאֲשֶׁר רָצִיתָ וְאָמַרְתָּ לְבָרְכֵנוּ כֵּן תְּבָרְכֵנוּ סֶלָה.
items.translation: Bestow on us, Adhonay our God, the blessing of Your festivals, for life, in gladness and in peace; as You desired and promised to bless us, so bless us, Selah.
items.translit: wĕhassiʾenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu ʾeth birkath mo'ădhekha lĕḥayyim bĕsimḥa uvĕshalom, kaʾăsher raṣitha wĕʾamarta lĕvarĕkhenu ken tĕvarĕkhenu sela.

items.hebrew: [בשבת: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, רְצֵה נָא בִּמְנוּחָתֵנוּ,] קַדְּשֵׁנוּ בְּמִצְוֹתֶיךָ, שִׂים חֶלְקֵנוּ בְּתוֹרָתָךְ, שַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבָךְ, שַׂמֵּחַ נַפְשֵׁנוּ בִּישׁוּעָתָךְ, וְטַהֵר לִבֵּנוּ לְעָבְדְּךָ בֶאֱמֶת, וְהַנְחִילֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ [בשבת: בְּאַהֲבָה וּבְרָצוֹן] בְּשִׂמְחָה וּבְשָׂשׂוֹן [בשבת: שַׁבָּתוֹת וּ]מוֹעֲדֵי קָדְשֶׁךָ, וְיִשְׂמְחוּ בְּךָ כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל מְקַדְּשֵׁי שְׁמֶךָ. בָּרוּךְ אַתָּה יְיָ, מְקַדֵּשׁ [בשבת: הַשַּׁבָּת וְ]יִשְׂרָאֵל וְהַזְּמַנִּים:
items.translation: [On Shabbath: Our God and God of our forefathers, find favor, we pray, in our rest.] Sanctify us with Your commandments and grant us our portion in Your Torah; satisfy us from Your goodness and gladden our souls with Your salvation, and purify our hearts to serve You in truth. Give us as our heritage, Adhonay our God, [on Shabbath: in love and favor,] in gladness and in joy, Your holy [on Shabbath: Shabbaths and] festivals, and may all Israel, who sanctify Your name, rejoice in You. Blessed are You, Adhonay, who sanctifies [on Shabbath: the Shabbath and] Israel and the seasons.
items.translit: [on Shabbath: ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, rĕṣeh naʾ bimnuḥathenu,] qaddĕshenu bĕmiṣwothekha, sim ḥelqenu bĕthorathakh, sabbĕ'enu miṭṭuvakh, sammeaḥ nafshenu bishu'athakh, wĕṭaher libbenu lĕ'avĕdĕkha veʾĕmeth, wĕhanḥilenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu [on Shabbath: bĕʾahăva uvĕraṣon] bĕsimḥa uvĕsason [on Shabbath: shabbathoth u]mo'ădhe qodhshekha, wĕyismĕḥu bĕkha kol yisraʾel mĕqaddĕshe shĕmekha. barukh ʾatta Adhonay, mĕqaddesh [on Shabbath: hashshabbath w]yisraʾel wĕhazzĕmannim:

items.translation: On Pesaḥ:

items.hebrew: חַג הַמַּצּוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם [ביום טוב: טוֹב] מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן חֵרוּתֵנוּ,
items.translation: this Festival of Maṣṣoth, this [on yom ṭov: festival] day set apart, the season of our freedom,
items.translit: ḥagh hammaṣṣoth hazzeh, ʾeth yom [on yom ṭov: ṭov] miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman ḥeruthenu,

items.translation: On Shavu'oth:

items.hebrew: חַג הַשָּׁבוּעוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן מַתַּן תּוֹרָתֵֽינוּ,
items.translation: this Festival of Shavu'oth, this festival day set apart, the season of the giving of our Torah,
items.translit: ḥagh hashshavu'oth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman mattan torathenu,

items.translation: On Sukkoth:

items.hebrew: חַג הַסֻּכּוֹת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם [ביום טוב: טוֹב] מִקְרָא קֹֽדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵֽנוּ,
items.translation: this Festival of Sukkoth, this [on yom ṭov: festival] day set apart, the season of our rejoicing,
items.translit: ḥagh hassukkoth hazzeh, ʾeth yom [on yom ṭov: ṭov] miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman simḥathenu,

items.translation: On Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth:

items.hebrew: שְׁמִינִי חַג עֲצֶרֶת הַזֶּה, אֶת יוֹם טוֹב מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, זְמַן שִׂמְחָתֵנוּ,
items.translation: this Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth, the Festival of Assembly, this festival day set apart, the season of our rejoicing,
items.translit: shĕmini ḥagh 'ăṣereth hazzeh, ʾeth yom ṭov miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, zĕman simḥathenu,

items.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ, מִפְּנֵי חֲטָאֵינוּ גָּלִינוּ מֵאַרְצֵנוּ, וְנִתְרַחַקְנוּ מֵעַל אַדְמָתֵנוּ, וְאֵין אֲנַחְנוּ יְכוֹלִים לַעֲלוֹת וְלֵרָאוֹת וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֹת לְפָנֶיךָ בְּבֵית בְּחִירָתָךְ, בִּנְוֵה הֲדָרָךְ, בַּבַּיִת הַגָּדוֹל וְהַקָּדוֹשׁ שֶׁנִּקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלָיו, מִפְּנֵי הַיָּד שֶׁנִּשְׁתַּלְּחָה בְּמִקְדָּשָׁךְ.
items.translation: Our God and God of our forefathers, because of our failings we were exiled from our land and sent far from our soil. We cannot go up, appear and bow down before You in the House of Your choosing, in Your glorious abode, the great and holy House upon which Your name is called, because of the hand sent forth against Your sanctuary.
items.translit: ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, mippĕne ḥăṭaʾenu galinu meʾarṣenu, wĕnithraḥaqnu me'al ʾadhmathenu, wĕʾen ʾănaḥnu yĕkholim la'ăloth wĕleraʾoth ulĕhishtaḥăwoth lĕfanekha bĕveth bĕḥirathakh, binweh hădharakh, babbayīth haggadhol wĕhaqqadhosh shenniqraʾ shimkha 'alaw, mippĕne hayyadh shennishtallĕḥa bĕmiqdashakh.

items.hebrew: יְהִי רָצוֹן מִלְּפָנֶיךָ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן, שֶׁתָּשׁוּב וּתְרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּרַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים, וְתִבְנֵהוּ מְהֵרָה וּתְגַדֵּל כְּבוֹדוֹ. אָבִינוּ, מַלְכֵּנוּ, אֱלֹהֵינוּ, גַּלֵּה כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ עָלֵינוּ מְהֵרָה, וְהוֹפַע וְהִנָּשֵׂא עָלֵינוּ לְעֵינֵי כָל חַי, וְקָרֵב פְּזוּרֵינוּ מִבֵּין הַגּוֹיִם, וּנְפוּצוֹתֵינוּ כַּנֵּס מִיַּרְכְּתֵי אָרֶץ, וַהֲבִיאֵנוּ יְיָ אֱלֹהֵינוּ לְצִיּוֹן עִירָךְ בְּרִנָּה, וְלִירוּשָׁלַיִם עִיר מִקְדָּשְׁךָ בְּשִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם, אָנָּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ, וְשָׁם נַעֲשֶׂה לְפָנֶיךָ אֶת קָרְבְּנוֹת חוֹבוֹתֵינוּ, תְּמִידִים כְּסִדְרָם וּמוּסָפִים כְּהִלְכָתָם.
items.translation: May it be Your will, Adhonay our God and God of our forefathers, compassionate King, to return and have mercy on us and on Your sanctuary in Your great compassion; rebuild it soon and magnify its glory. Our Father, our King, our God — reveal the glory of Your kingship upon us soon; appear and be exalted over us before the eyes of all the living. Draw our scattered ones near from among the nations, and gather our dispersed from the ends of the earth. Bring us, Adhonay our God, to Zion, Your city, in song, and to Jerusalem, the city of Your sanctuary, in everlasting joy. We beseech You, our God: there we will offer before You the offerings we owe — the daily offerings in their order and the additional offerings according to their law.
items.translit: yĕhi raṣon millĕfanekha Adhonay ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, melekh raḥăman, shettashuv uthĕraḥem 'alenu wĕ'al miqdashĕkha bĕraḥămekha harabbim, wĕthivnehu mĕhera uthĕghaddel kĕvodho. ʾavinu, malkenu, ʾĕlohenu, galleh kĕvodh malkhuthĕkha 'alenu mĕhera, wĕhofa' wĕhinnaseʾ 'alenu lĕ'ene khol ḥay, wĕqarev pĕzurenu mibben haggoyīm, unĕfuṣothenu kannes miyyarkĕthe ʾareṣ, wahăviʾenu Adhonay ʾĕlohenu lĕṣiyyon 'irakh bĕrinna, wĕlirushalayim 'ir miqdashĕkha bĕsimḥath 'olam, ʾannaʾ ʾĕlohenu, wĕsham na'ăseh lĕfanekha ʾeth qorbĕnoth ḥovothenu, tĕmidhim kĕsidhram umusafim kĕhilkhatham.

items.hebrew: אֶת מוּסַף [בשבת: מוּסְפֵי יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת הַזֶּה, וְ]יוֹם
items.translation: The additional offering of [on Shabbath: this Shabbath day, and] the day of
items.translit: ʾeth musaf [on Shabbath: musĕfe yom hashshabbath hazzeh, w]yom

items.translation: On Pesaḥ:
this Festival of Maṣṣoth
items.translit: ḥagh hammaṣṣoth

items.translation: On Shavu'oth:
this Festival of Shavu'oth
items.translit: ḥagh hashshavu'oth

items.translation: On Sukkoth:
this Festival of Sukkoth
items.translit: ḥagh hassukkoth

items.translation: On Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth:
this Shĕmini 'Ăṣereth, the Festival of Assembly
items.translit: shĕmini ḥagh 'ăṣereth

items.hebrew: הַזֶּה, וְיוֹם [ביום טוב: טוֹב] מִקְרָא קֹדֶשׁ הַזֶּה, נַעֲשֶׂה וְנַקְרִיב לְפָנֶיךָ בְּאַהֲבָה כְּמִצְוַת רְצוֹנָךְ, כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְתָּ עָלֵינוּ בְּתוֹרָתָךְ, עַל יְדֵי מֹשֶׁה עַבְדֶּךָ.
items.translation: and of this [on yom ṭov: festival] day set apart, we will prepare and bring before You in love, as Your will commanded, as You wrote for us in Your Torah by the hand of Moses Your servant.
items.translit: hazzeh, wĕyom [on yom ṭov: ṭov] miqraʾ qodhesh hazzeh, na'ăseh wĕnaqriv lĕfanekha bĕʾahăva kĕmiṣwath rĕṣonakh, kĕmo shekkathavta 'alenu bĕthorathakh, 'al yĕdhe mosheh 'avdekha.

items.hebrew: אֱלֹהֵינוּ וֵאלֹהֵי אֲבוֹתֵינוּ, מֶלֶךְ רַחֲמָן רַחֵם עָלֵינוּ, טוֹב וּמֵטִיב הִדָּרֶשׁ לָנוּ, שׁוּבָה עָלֵינוּ בַּהֲמוֹן רַחֲמֶיךָ, בִּגְלַל אָבוֹת שֶׁעָשׂוּ רְצוֹנֶךָ, בְּנֵה בֵיתְךָ כְּבַתְּחִלָּה, כּוֹנֵן בֵּית מִקְדָּשְׁךָ עַל מְכוֹנוֹ, הַרְאֵנוּ בְּבִנְיָנוֹ, שַׂמְּחֵנוּ בְּתִקּוּנוֹ, וְהָשֵׁב שְׁכִינָתְךָ לְתוֹכוֹ, וְהָשֵׁב כֹּהֲנִים לַעֲבוֹדָתָם, וּלְוִיִּים לְדוּכָנָם, לְשִׁירָם וּלְזִמְרָם, וְהָשֵׁב יִשְׂרָאֵל לִנְוֵיהֶם. וְשָׁם נַעֲלֶה וְנֵרָאֶה וְנִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה לְפָנֶיךָ בְּשָׁלֹשׁ פַּעֲמֵי רְגָלֵינוּ בְּכָל שָׁנָה וְשָׁנָה, כַּכָּתוּב בַּתּוֹרָה שָׁל֣וֹשׁ פְּעָמִ֣ים ׀ בַּשָּׁנָ֡ה יֵרָאֶ֨ה כׇל־זְכוּרְךָ֜ אֶת־פְּנֵ֣י ׀ יְיָ֣ אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בַּמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִבְחָ֔ר בְּחַ֧ג הַמַּצּ֛וֹת וּבְחַ֥ג הַשָּׁבֻע֖וֹת וּבְחַ֣ג הַסֻּכּ֑וֹת וְלֹ֧א יֵרָאֶ֛ה אֶת־פְּנֵ֥י יְיָ֖ רֵיקָֽם׃ אִ֖ישׁ כְּמַתְּנַ֣ת יָד֑וֹ כְּבִרְכַּ֛ת יְיָ֥ אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽתַן־לָֽךְ׃
items.translation: Our God and God of our forefathers, compassionate King, have mercy on us; good and beneficent One, let Yourself be sought by us. Return to us in the abundance of Your compassion, for the sake of the forefathers who did Your will. Build Your House as at the beginning, and establish Your sanctuary on its foundation; let us see it rebuilt, and gladden us in its restoration. Return Your Presence to its midst, restore the priests to their service and the Levites to their platform, to their song and their music, and restore Israel to their homes. There we will go up, appear and bow down before You on our three pilgrim feasts, each and every year, as it is written in the Torah: Three times a year all your males shall appear before Adhonay your God in the place that He will choose — on the Festival of Maṣṣoth, on the Festival of Shavu'oth and on the Festival of Sukkoth — and they shall not appear before Adhonay empty-handed. Each shall give as he is able, according to the blessing that Adhonay your God has given you.
items.translit: ʾĕlohenu weʾlohe ʾăvothenu, melekh raḥăman raḥem 'alenu, ṭov umeṭiv hiddaresh lanu, shuva 'alenu bahămon raḥămekha, bighlal ʾavoth she'asu rĕṣonekha, bĕneh vethĕkha kĕvattĕḥilla, konen beth miqdashĕkha 'al mĕkhono, harʾenu bĕvinyano, sammĕḥenu bĕthiqquno, wĕhashev shĕkhinathĕkha lĕthokho, wĕhashev kohănim la'ăvodhatham, ulĕwiyyim lĕdhukhanam, lĕshiram ulĕzimram, wĕhashev yisraʾel linwehem. wĕsham na'ăleh wĕneraʾeh wĕnishtaḥăweh lĕfanekha bĕshalosh pa'ăme rĕghalenu bĕkhol shana wĕshana, kakkathuv battora shalosh pĕ'amim bashshana yeraʾeh khol-zĕkhurĕkha ʾeth-fĕne Adhonay ʾĕlohekha bammaqom ʾăsher yivḥar bĕḥagh hammaṣṣoth uvĕḥagh hashshavu'oth uvĕḥagh hassukkoth wĕloʾ yeraʾeh ʾeth-fĕne Adhonay reqam. ʾish kĕmattĕnath yadho kĕvirkath Adhonay ʾĕlohekha ʾăsher nathan-lakh.
